traffic_alerts.description: Burst when a route turns HEAVY or JAM

number_font.description: Face for the drive-time digits (BDF from assets/fonts)

destinations.description: Destinations to show, two per screen (more take turns)

label.description: Short display name e.g. WORK (8 characters max)

free_flow_entity.description: Sensor with the drive time without traffic (e.g. HERE's duration sensor). Used as the free-flow baseline.

typical_minutes.description: Fixed free-flow drive time; overrides free_flow_entity. Default: free_flow_entity, else the shortest time seen.
